out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Observed handwashing sink in the rear kitchen and the front counter did not have posters for handwashing
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC replaced the handwashing posters

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Surfaces of the ice tea dispensers and consumer self service utensils are not being cleaned as required. Ice machine is not clean to sight and touch
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. PIC agreed to clean the inside of the ice machine

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Snaiztier test kits expired in 2023
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC ordered new texts kit for CL based sanitizer

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation System Cleaning
violations.observation: Intake and exhaust air ducts are not being cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent contamination by dust, dirt, and other materials. Vents throughout the facility were in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Clean intake and exhaust air ducts at regularly intervals to prevent them from becoming sources of contamination. PIC agreed to clean the ventilation system

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during inspection.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: cooked boba and cooked mini boba.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM will make a label and place near containers of 4 hour time frame bobas are being served.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting boards hanging near the 3 compartment sink are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition. Observed thin, heavily scratched cutting boards in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. CFM will discard cutting boards.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED1 DR PREP WITH ACCUMULATION OF CONDENSATION ON BOTTOM OF INTERIOR UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: CFM WILL CALL FOR REPAIR OF UNIT. EHS RECOMMENDED TO KEEP INTERIOR OF UNIT DRY, BUT NOT TO LEAVE TOWELS IN UNIT.
